title: Free-frame list
purpose: Show a linked list of available physical-frame numbers, preserving the example values.
requiredChecks: Head points to frame7, then97,15,126,ellipsis,75 in this order.
Every link is unidirectional to the next free frame and no circular link is invented.
Title and annotation identify this as a list of available physical frames, not a page reference string.
All six example tokens and the head label are readable.
alt: Free-frame linked list: head points through available frames 7, 97, 15, 126, …, 75
prompt: Create a NEW original technical educational diagram for an English operating-systems blog. White background, dark navy crisp sans-serif text, blue and teal flat boxes, clean thin arrows, ample whitespace, large legible labels, no copied textbook artwork, no logos or watermark. TITLE "Free-frame list". A wide landscape educational diagram with exactly this simple left-to-right chain: "head" → box "7" → box "97" → box "15" → box "126" → plain ellipsis "…" → box "75". Connectors all point to the right. Uniform blue/teal boxes and clear navy arrows; no circular pointer, no extra frame values. Subtitle exactly "Available physical frames". Footer exactly "Allocate a free frame when a page must be loaded". Frame identifiers are examples, NOT a memory-reference string. Keep a compact layout with generous margins; no other illustrations.
